content:
Jeff: Heads-up — thinking of shifting this week's triage to Wed and shrinking it to 20m. Need quick ✅ on owner coverage and agenda
Maria: Why Wed? we usually do Tue. what's the motivation?
Jeff: Mid-sprint pulse seems more useful for quick rollouts + regressions. Also frees Tues for design reviews.
Simon: @Jeff Wed works for me. prefer 11:15-11:35 to avoid customer call at noon.
Rachael: I can cover backlog + owner assigns, but let's cap at 3 live items. otherwise it's a time sink.
OpsBot: Calendar action: proposed event 'Midweek Triage (20m)' Wed 11:15-11:35 — please accept/decline via the invite.
Elaine: Can we keep a 5m hotfix slot for urgent rollouts/regressions?
Jeff: Yes. Proposed micro-agenda (trial):
```
1) 3 quick items — owner + next action (8m)
2) hotfix lane — urgent regressions (5m)
3) rollout/metric flags — quick status (4m)
4) followups / async handoffs (3m)
```
Maria: SGTM. Also quick FYI: pls ping PRs blocking CI — two builds are queued and need review.
Simon: +1. If we hit >3 items we move extras to async and assign owners there.
Rachael: Ack — I'll shepherd owners during the call. @Simon can you curate the PR list before meeting?
Simon: Yep — will post PR list in #eng-async 30m before the call.
OpsBot: Reminder scheduled: 15 minutes before event for attendees.
Jeff: :thumbsup: let's run this as a 2-week trial and evaluate. If it's too tight we revert.
Maria: Suggest adding "eval regressions" quick-check to rollout section for any red alerts.
Jeff: Added to the template. I'll update the calendar event body with the agenda and links.
Rachael: :raised_hands: good. Anyone can't make 11:15 Wed?
Elaine: I have a calendar conflict 11:20-11:40 but can join from 11:25. hope that's ok for a 20m slot.
Maria: Minor conflict until 11:10, 11:15 works for me.
Simon: All good from my side.
Jeff: Great — OpsBot will create the trial event. Post-call note: if we overflow, start a thread named 'triage-overflow' and tag owners.
Rachael: I'll take post-call notes and drop action items in #eng-ops.
OpsBot: Event created: Midweek Triage (20m) — Wed 11:15 - 11:35. Attendees: Jeff, Maria, Simon, Rachael, Elaine. Calendar invites sent.
Maria: Thanks — appreciate the tighter format.
Simon: Quick ask: can we add a one-line pre-read in the invite for any item that needs >30s context? helps keep things short.
Jeff: Good call. I'll ask folks to add a 1-liner in the event body or the async thread.
Rachael: Perfect — see you all Wed. :calendar:
